BusinessAutomationDemo.title: Order Processing
BusinessAutomationDemo.description: Here's a sample list of orders received by a business.
BusinessAutomationDemo.resultsDescription: Some orders need a quick review before they can be processed.
BusinessAutomationDemo.allReady: All orders are ready to process.
BusinessAutomationDemo.initialInstructions: Click Process Orders to see which orders are ready and which ones need attention.
BusinessAutomationDemo.welcomeDescription: Discover how a business can automatically identify errors in incoming orders, correct them, and prepare them for the next step.
BusinessAutomationDemo.welcomeNote: You can exit the guided tour at any time.
BusinessAutomationDemo.tourIntroTitle: Turn incoming orders into reliable data
BusinessAutomationDemo.tourIntroDescription: Automatically check incoming orders, flag problems, and correct only what needs attention—so your team can focus on the next step.
BusinessAutomationDemo.tourOrdersDescription: These six orders represent the data your business receives every day. Some contain missing or incorrect information. Automation checks every record so your team can focus on the exceptions.
BusinessAutomationDemo.tourValidationDescription: Click Process Orders to check all six records automatically. The system flags missing customer names and invalid quantities, saving your team from checking every order manually.
BusinessAutomationDemo.tourValidationResults: {ready} orders passed validation and {attention} need attention. The highlighted table shows which records have problems, so your team can focus on the exceptions.
BusinessAutomationDemo.tourFixDescription: The summary separates valid orders from those needing attention. Enter a customer name for ORD-003 and a positive quantity for ORD-005, then click Reprocess. Your team handles the exceptions while automation checks the data again.
BusinessAutomationDemo.tourFixCompleted: All corrections passed validation. The summary now shows {ready} orders ready and {attention} needing attention.
BusinessAutomationDemo.tourCompleteTitle: All clear. Ready for the next step.
BusinessAutomationDemo.tourCompleteDescription: All {ready} orders have been validated. Your team only needed to correct the exceptions, without manually checking every record.
BusinessAutomationDemo.tourCompleteNextSteps: This demo stops at validation. In a real workflow, validated orders could continue to invoicing, inventory, a CRM, or notifications—depending on your business needs.
BusinessAutomationDemo.mobileGuidedNotice: For the guided experience, open this demo on desktop.
BusinessAutomationDemo.mobileWelcomeDescription: Try processing orders, fixing errors, and checking the results.
BusinessAutomationDemo.mobileGuidedMessage: For the guided experience, open this demo on desktop.

BusinessInsightsDemo.title: Clear Business Insights
BusinessInsightsDemo.description: Understand your sales, spot trends, and see which products drive revenue. Change the filters to explore the data.
BusinessInsightsDemo.comparisonRange: Compared with {start} – {end}, using the same category filter.
BusinessInsightsDemo.timelineDescription: Explore the bars for exact sales figures. Dashed lines mark the highest and lowest periods.
BusinessInsightsDemo.categoryDescription: Compare revenue across the selected categories.
BusinessInsightsDemo.productsDescription: Products ranked by revenue for the selected period and category.
BusinessInsightsDemo.sampleNote: Sample data — for demonstration purposes. All sales and orders are fictional.
